summary: Frontend-only visual regression test for Home hero clutter/spacing fix. Verified at 1440x810 and 1920x900. Navbar logo does not overlap kicker or headline; clear vertical gap (~76px @1440, ~121px @1920) between logo bottom and kicker top. 'Composed Living' fully visible with 'g' descender not clipped. Rituals & Designs subheading, description, and both hero CTA buttons visible and well spaced. Regression: hero-explore-btn → /shop, hero-about-btn → /about both navigate correctly.
